opening.argument: The presentation ties Forsage slots to repeated ETH returns: it says the 0.1 ETH slot generates 0.1 ETH “over and over again” and the 0.2 ETH slot generates 0.2 ETH “again and again.” The graphics reinforce a tiered structure, showing numbered x3 and x4 groups with increasing displayed amounts, while another frame connects a 0.1 slot to three smaller figures alongside an Ethereum Wallet panel. Registration is directed through direct message. Together, these details present slot-based returns alongside a recruitment structure and a route to register, supporting the concern that this is a recruitment-commission scheme. The excerpts do not establish slot prices, actual transfers, or whether anyone received the depicted returns.
